findingsNew.title: SKILL.md next-number helper still ignores archived packets
findingsNew.scopeProof: grep finds only SKILL.md:295 as a documented next-number helper; create.sh:1644 and :1813 count z_archive.
findingsNew.claim: The documented next-number one-liner counts only live root folders while create.sh counts archived packets at the root and phase paths.

findingsNew.title: Relocation feature catalog omits relocate.mjs exit status 3
findingsNew.scopeProof: runtime/cli/spec/README.md:120 documents status 3; the catalog paragraph does not, so the stale consumer is local to the catalog.
findingsNew.claim: The catalog lists only statuses 0, 1 and 2 and assigns a failed close to 2, while relocate.mjs returns 3 for a landed move whose packet validation failed.

findingsNew.title: Lifecycle catalog restore paragraph contradicts phase 008 verdict and omits mixed-track refusal
findingsNew.scopeProof: The paragraph is the only restore-verdict text in the lifecycle catalog; archive.sh:432-440 and :363-395 carry behaviours it does not state.
findingsNew.claim: The catalog says a failed relocate run makes a restore exit 1 and omits the mixed-track refusal, while archive.sh treats status 3 as success and refuses a mixed-track restore.
